edges.reason: msg.sender is passed into hasRole(MANAGER_ROLE, msg.sender) inside the onlyManager modifier.
MANAGER_ROLE identifies the role required by the onlyManager guard.
onlyManager gates execution of setUnlockSchedule.
onlyManager gates execution of setDiggPegRewards.
initialAdmin_ is granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE inside initialize.
initialManager_ is granted MANAGER_ROLE inside initialize.
gatedLogBatcherLib_ is written into the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
GUARD_VALUE is assigned to the guard storage slot during initialization.
initialize references MANAGER_ROLE when calling _setupRole.
beneficiary indexes unlockSchedules and is stored in the new schedule.
token is stored in the pushed UnlockSchedule.
totalAmount is stored in the pushed UnlockSchedule.
start is stored in the pushed UnlockSchedule.
end is stored in the pushed UnlockSchedule.
duration is stored in the pushed UnlockSchedule.
block.timestamp is emitted in UnlockScheduleSet, creating a block-time dependency.
setUnlockSchedule writes into the unlockSchedules mapping.
beneficiary is emitted in the DiggPegRewards event.
response is emitted in the DiggPegRewards event.
rate is emitted in the DiggPegRewards event.
block.timestamp is emitted in DiggPegRewards, creating a block-time dependency.
Attacker-supplied logs bytes enters batchLogs as a parameter.
batchLogs reads the guard state variable to decide whether it is running under delegatecall.
guard is compared against GUARD_VALUE to block direct calls.
gatedLogBatcherLib supplies the target address of the delegatecall.
batchLogs transfers control to external code through delegatecall.
The delegatecalled library code executes in this contract's context, allowing reentrant execution paths.
logs is abi-encoded into the delegatecall payload multiSend(bytes), letting the caller influence the executed code.
beneficiary selects which schedule array is returned.
beneficiary selects the schedule array to filter.
token is compared against schedule.token during filtering.
getUnlockSchedulesFor reads unlockSchedules[beneficiary].
getAllUnlockSchedulesFor reads unlockSchedules[beneficiary].
The mapping entry is loaded into the local schedules array.
Each iteration loads schedule = schedules[i].
The loaded schedule's token field is compared to the requested token.
numMatchingEntries is computed inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
numMatchingEntries determines the size of the result array.
results are written at resultIndex.
i is the loop counter of both filtering loops.
i indexes into the schedules array to obtain the current schedule element.

initialManager_ is only used to grant MANAGER_ROLE inside initialize; fold into the initialize node.

end is consumed only by setUnlockSchedule; fold into that function.
duration is consumed only by setUnlockSchedule; fold into that function.
beneficiary is consumed only by setDiggPegRewards; fold into that function.
response is consumed only by setDiggPegRewards; fold into that function.
rate is consumed only by setDiggPegRewards; fold into that function.

beneficiary is only used to index unlockSchedules in getAllUnlockSchedulesFor.
beneficiary is only used to index unlockSchedules in getUnlockSchedulesFor.
token is only used for filtering inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
schedules is a transient memory copy inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
numMatchingEntries is a transient counter inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
result is a transient return array inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
resultIndex is a transient write cursor inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
i is a transient loop counter inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
schedule is a transient struct element inside getUnlockSchedulesFor.
